# Andrej Karpathy

Researcher and educator. Foundational thinker for both [[wiki-memory]]{.related} and [[agentic-engineering]]{.related} as practices.

His Agentic Wiki Design Document (gist, April 2026) formalized the wiki-memory pattern: three layers (raw sources immutable, LLM-owned wiki, schema document governing behavior), three operations (ingest with fan-out, query with optional file-back, lint as first-class). The [[compounding-knowledge]]{.related} claim originates here — "the wiki gets richer over time rather than being re-derived per query."

His Sequoia Ascent 2026 talk "Software 3.0 and Agentic Engineering" framed the broader discipline: LLMs as a programmable medium, not just a wrapped component. The talk identified practical patterns for building, evaluating, and operating production agent systems — making explicit that engineering with LLMs is a distinct discipline from traditional software engineering or machine-learning operations.

Both threads — memory architecture and engineering practice — connect via the underlying commitment to durable, structured representations of knowledge that survive across sessions, across model versions, and across agent instances.
